analysis_scope: training labels only; frozen test voxel arrays not accessed
augmentation_boundary: future augmentation operates after deterministic patch extraction and before tensor conversion while preserving MRI-label correspondence

boundary_policy.if_padding_is_required: MRI padding 0 after normalization; label padding background class 0; crop/reconstruct with exact MRI-label correspondence
boundary_policy.training: constrain centers to full in-volume patches initially; no training padding for the baseline sampler

class_aware_weighting.unknown_label_policy: fail closed; never sample unknown IDs

epoch_definition.multi_record_group_policy: group first; record second uniformly within group

materialization_recommendation: lazy patch generation first; no patch arrays/caches for the initial implementation

participant_group_balancing.policy: select participant_group_id uniformly first, then one training record in that group, then patch strategy and center

test_inference: identical to validation, run only after model selection is complete

validation_inference.blending: Gaussian logit blending if available; otherwise average logits
validation_inference.grid_policy: regular grid plus final boundary-flush windows
